supersedes.reason: The v1 root overstated the affected surface and test evidence. V2 narrows the root and makes adjacent uncovered seams explicit.

truthScope: The known root covers ordinary local files created during List._refresh whose configured type reaches File.type but is ignored when selecting a script tag MIME type. Absolute URL patterns and watcher-added files lose the configured type earlier and are disclosed as separate seams, not credited as this root.
limitations: The motivating PR example is an absolute Google Fonts URL, but the defect-bearing head constructs Url(pattern) without forwarding Pattern.type.
List.addFile constructs new File(path) for watcher-added files and therefore also loses Pattern.type.
Later commits repair script selection for refresh-loaded local files but do not add an explicit script-type regression test in the reviewed test file.
